description: This file defines the class tlTestCaseFilterByRequirementControl, which extends tlFilterControl to manage filters and GUI logic for filtering test cases by requirements in the TestLink project. It contains methods for initializing filters, managing session data, and building test case trees based on mode and user input. The class is used within the TestLink application to support filtering, session management, and UI interactions related to test case filtering by requirement parameters.

classes.name: tlTestCaseFilterByRequirementControl
classes.description: Class extending tlFilterControl to handle GUI filtering, session management, and test case tree building based on requirements mode in TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing filter mode, session data, and related managers.

methods.name: read_config
methods.description: Loads configuration settings specific to test case filtering.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Reads user input from request and initializes filter parameters.

methods.name: init_settings
methods.description: Initializes filter display settings based on mode and configurations.

methods.name: init_filters
methods.description: Activates filters based on configuration and user input.

methods.name: get_active_filters
methods.description: Returns current filters, as array or object, based on mode.

methods.name: set_testcases_to_show
methods.description: Sets which test cases to display and updates session data.

methods.name: save_session_data
methods.description: Stores active filter state in session with a form token.

methods.description: Cleans up outdated session filter data based on timestamp.
